preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the tree is between 2 and 2 * 10^5, and the distance limit d is between 2 and n.
Each edge in the tree connects nodes between 1 and n.
The first piece has a sequence of nodes to pass with a length between 1 and n.
The second piece has a sequence of nodes to pass with a length between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output must be an integer representing the minimum steps needed to move the two pieces.
